texts.error.bad_image: '%1' has the size and checksum of %2, but it is not the same image.
texts.error.bad_zip: '%1' is not a readable ZIP file.
texts.error.no_game: No game file is in the project.
texts.error.no_machine: There was not enough memory to make the machine.
texts.error.not_plain: %1 needs %2, which this core does not support. It plays only XaviX games that use a plain pad.
texts.error.save_name: The save data file is named '%1'. Only the file this core exports for the game, '%2', can be put back.
texts.error.save_size: '%1' is %2 bytes. The game's save data is %3 bytes.
texts.error.too_large: '%1' is too large to be a XaviX game.
texts.error.unknown_game: '%1' is not a XaviX game this core knows. Give it a game's ZIP file as MAME names it (such as epo_ebox.zip) or its bare ROM image.
texts.reason.analog: analog sticks or a steering wheel
texts.slot.game.help: The XaviX game: its ZIP file as MAME names it (such as epo_ebox.zip), or its bare ROM image (.bin). Only the exact images XaviXEmu knows are accepted.
texts.slot.savedata.help: The game's remembered data to start with, in place of a fresh game. This is the file that Emulator > Export Save Data... writes, named after the game (such as epo_ebox.sav). Put it back under the same name. The file is never changed. Leave it empty to start fresh.
